acceptance_criteria.description: Migrations recreate a clean local database; seed data are synthetic.
Foreign keys and checks enforce ownership, valid sides, units, durations and nonnegative repetition counts.

Document ERD, indexes and retention decisions; do not store passwords or raw videos in application tables.
